newsitem.title: USA: Evergreen Resources adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Evergreen Resources adopts rights plan.

text.p: Evergreen Resources Inc said Monday its board of directors had set a shareholder rights plan with a 20 percent trigger.
Under the plan, stock purchase rights will be distributed as a dividend to shareholders at a rate of one right for each share of common stock held of record as of July 22, the company said.
The rights, which expire July 22, 2007, would become exercisable if a person or group acquired or started a tender offer for 20 percent or more of the company's common stock.
The company said each right will initially represent the right to purchase one share of common stock for $42.50.

If a party acquired 20 percent of the company's common stock, the rights would be modified to represent the right to receive, for the exercise price, common stock having a value of twice the exercise price.
The rights are not triggered by continued stock ownership of the company's existing 20 percent shareholders, unless they increase their holdings above 30 percent.
The plan is not in response to any pending or threatened takeover effort, the company said.
